t: Hanniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur qorein qeriat shema o shehipsiq bishat haqqeria
s: Hanniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur qorein qeriat shema o shehipsiq bishat haqqeria ubo g' seipim: qeraah serugin, dehaynu shehitchil liqrot vehipsiq ben bishtiqa ben bedibbur vechazar ugemarah, apillu shaha kede ligmor et kullah — yatza, apillu im haya hahepseq mechamat ones. Veken bimgilla ubitqiat shopar. Abal bitpilla im shaha kede ligmor et kullah merosh ad sop — tzarik lachazor larosh. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq ben qeriat shema litpilla, ubekol maqom im shaha mechamat ones, sheap im haya rotzeh shello lishhot lo haya yakol — tzarik lachazor larosh, im shaha kede ligmor et kullah merosh ad sop velo mimmaqom sheshshoheh umapsiq bo ad sop, umeshaarin lepi haqqore velo lepi rob bene adam. Vaapillu bebirkat qeriat shema im shaha beemtza habberaka kede ligmor et kullah meroshah lesopah — tzarik lachazor larosh. Abal im hipsiq shello mechamat ones, sheim haya rotzeh haya qore veshaha birtzono vehipsiq ben bedibbur ben bishtiqa apillu zeman rab — en tzarik lachazor ella lammaqom sheppasaq. Veken yesh linhog halaka lemaaseh, ki ken iqqar. Veones zeh, yesh omerim apillu ones listim o ones acher, kol shello haya yakol liqrot apillu im ratza. Veyesh omerim sheeno chashub hepseq mechamat ones lachazor larosh ella im ken lo haya yakol liqrot mechamat shehaish eno rauy, kegon shehitchil liqrot qeriat shema vehitchilu me raglayv shotetin al birkayv vehutzrak lehapsiq ad sheyyiklu, o mechamat shehammaqom eno rauy liqria, kegon sheqqoreah mehallek vehiggia limboot hamtunnapot vehutzrak lehapsiq. Abal im haish o hammaqom reuyin ella sheones acher meakkebo umatzriko lehapsiq, apillu shaha zeman rab — chozer lammaqom sheppasaq. Uleinyan halaka — yesh mi sheomer shebbattepilla apillu beones acher chozer larosh, meachar sheyyesh omerim sheapillu beli ones kelal chozer larosh, abal biqriat shema en tzarik lachazor larosh ella im ken haish o hammaqom eno rauy:

Qara qeriat shema veniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur sheqqorin qeriat shema — tzarik liqrot immahem pasuq rishon, shello yeraeh keillu eno rotzeh leqabbel ol malkut shamayim im chaberayv. Vehu haddin shear dabar shehatztzibbur omerim, kegon "tehilla ledavid" — tzarik liqro immahem, shekken derek eretz. Vehu haddin im hu bebet hakkeneset veomer dibre tachanunim o pesuqim bemaqom sherashshay lipsoq. Abal im hu asuq bemaqom sheeno rashshay lipsoq, kegon mi"baruk sheamar" veelak — lo yapsiq, ella yomar hattebot shehu omer beshaa shehatztzibbur omerim pasuq rishon beniggun hatztzibbur, sheyyehe nireh keillu qore immahem. Veyesh omerim demapsiq apillu beemtza birkot qeriat shema, leqabbel ol malkut shamayim im hatztzibbur. Veyesh omerim debipsuqe dezimra yesh lehapsiq, abal babberakot shellipne qeriat shema en lehapsiq kelal bishbil pasuq rishon shel qeriat shema, ella yomar otan hattebot beniggun kemo shehatztzibbur omerim qeriat shema. Uleinyan halaka lemaaseh — kisbara hag', debipsuqe dezimra — yesh lehapsiq, ubeemtza habberakot shel qeriat shema — en lehapsiq, ella yomar hattebot beniggun hatztzibbur. Uman demapsiq bibrakot diqriat shema liqro pasuq rishon im hatztzibbur — rauy ligor bo:

Qara qeriat shema veniknas lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur sheqqorin qeriat shema — tob sheyyiqra immahem kol qeriat shema viqabbel sakar keqore battora. Abal eno chayyab raq bepasuq rishon, kemo shennitbaer:
